programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD

Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

We would provide a three-night stay on the stoked on a fishing yacht, two days of fishing on our Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot everglades, and provide fantastic food and drinks when we arrived back in Avalon. We love Catalina, and the idea of creating a hospital for the future of the Island was a no-brainer. We couldn't let this great opportunity go to waste and had epic two days of fishing in San Clemente Island with some new friends.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.sub-title: The Emerging Science of Longevity: Eating for Longevity
programme.desc: Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.sub-title: The Emerging Science of Longevity: Optimizing Health with the Fundamentals
programme.desc: There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. programme.title: The Emerging Science of Longevity
programme.sub-title: The Emerging Science of Longevity: Adversity Mimetics to Activate Healing and Repair

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 1
programme.desc: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 2
programme.desc: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 3
programme.desc: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 4
programme.desc: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.sub-title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 203
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.desc: Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

Spectators will witness an intense racing flow as players scramble for kitchen control, showcasing the technical skills required to navigate high-speed volleys and strategic double bounces. With Florida utilizing critical timeouts to regroup against Ohio State’s relentless pressure, the match transforms into a display of freestyle athleticism and raw competitive spirit. Don’t miss a second of the action as these elite collegiate athletes fight to keep their championship dreams alive.

programme.desc: Un resumen de las noticias más importantes antes de terminar el día.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El pasado oscuro; DUI mató a mi hijo
programme.desc: Daniel buscó a su esposa por mucho tiempo y, ahora que logra encontrarla, descubre que ella está casada con otro. El marido de Alejandra conducía ebrio y por accidente mata al hijo de Willie.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dalila, modelo de pasarela, fue discriminada en el evento que organizó Karla, le impidieron participar por tener síndrome de Down sin tomar en cuenta su enorme talento para desfilar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: José, el enano; Problema de niños
programme.desc: Lourdes está casada con José, ella le exige que acepte su discapacidad, pero él se niega porque se siente sano y fuerte. Dos niñas se enfrentan por unos "tickets" para ir a Euro Disney en París.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Aire mortal; El emú y la esmeralda
programme.desc: Ernesto sufre las consecuencias de tener un vecino obsesionado con las armas. Además, Lily exige que un emú sea operado porque se tragó la esmeralda que estaba en su anillo de matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Peligro de mar; La venganza del huevo
programme.desc: George tuvo un accidente en bote con su hija y ahora la madre exige la custodia, porque el padre alcoholizado no supo cuidarla. Roni mete huevos en las paredes por venganza contra su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hermana de Stefany murió de sobredosis y ella exige la herencia que la difunta le dejó a su secta sexual. Ashley parece menor de edad y extorsiona con sexo, su hermana pide desalojarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alberto busca hospitalizar a su mujer embarazada, porque ella consume marihuana para controlar la epilepsia. Zarina trabaja como modelo en la empresa de Sistina, le exigen prostituirse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Me duele mucho; El más buscado
programme.desc: Ángel cree que su mamá tiene relaciones con el enfermero, pero quien las mantiene es su padre. Aura toma fotos de sus hijos desnudos, ahora uno de ellos dice que las gráficas lo perjudican.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Subastando la muerte; El reto de los ojos vendados
programme.desc: Un hombre enloquece y dispara en un centro comercial, el padre de un fallecido exige las armas del asesino para destruirlas. Jóvenes se vendan los ojos y realizan actividades peligrosas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Descarada sin vergüenza; Por un par de nalgas
programme.desc: Andrés busca anular el matrimonio de su hermano discapacitado porque Tairy se aprovecha de él. Cristina le aumenta los glúteos a Tatiana y la inyecta, ella hackea su Facebook para denunciarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Adolescente maldito; Billete sucio ganado limpio
programme.desc: Santiago, entrenador de tenis, pierde su trabajo porque María lo acusa de acosar sexualmente a su hijo. Por culpa de Ángel, la policía le incauta un dinero falso y con rastros de coca a Nicole.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis le exige el divorcio a José porque se fue de viaje y le ocultó que su madre le pegó a los niños. Daniela exige que Esteban se someta a una terapia para eliminar su fetiche de voyerista.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Explotación de hombres; Papá está vivo
programme.desc: Tony cree que los videos de Alejandra para cazar un Sugar Daddy son su perdición. Jaqueline autoriza la desconexión de un hombre hospitalizado, pero este resultó ser el padre de otra persona.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Vivienda robada; Las fiancées del marinero
programme.desc: Paola exige que Tatiana le pague la renta o desaloje su casa, pero ella pagó a la inmobiliaria. La novia de Nahuel le pone una visa "fiancé" y se la niegan porque la ex, Elizabeth, tenía otra.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrea pide 15 mil dólares y orden de alejamiento para Jessica, quien le dio testosterona. Roxana exige que su ex retire de internet los videos que publicó para probar que era un cornudo feliz.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Recuperar mi herencia; Mujer o mujer trans
programme.desc: Exige el divorcio, su esposo la engañó con la amante y extrajo dinero de la cuenta, según ella, para matar a su difunto padre. A Juliana le cancelan el contrato porque creen que no es mujer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mamá drag; El poder del hombre moreno
programme.desc: Carmen recupera a su hija, pero Lucía y Alejandro insisten en que la niña estaba mejor bajo sus cuidados. No quiere que su anciana madre practique la kunyaza, una técnica de placer sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Nos quitó la vida; Venganza de la ex
programme.desc: Quiere ser la guardiana del amigo de su hijo para llenar el espacio que él dejó al morir. Escapa para evitar ser descubierto y se lesiona, ahora no puede practicar su pasión: el paracaidismo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Como anillo al dedo; Sacada de sangre mortal
programme.desc: La boda entre Jenifer y su novio se cancela, pero ella se niega a devolver el anillo de compromiso. Teresa contrata a John como enfermero, una inyección demostró que él es un farsante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos y John quieren adoptar a las gemelas de Orlando, quienes se quedaron sin mamá. Además, despiden a Zuli del bar donde trabajaba porque no supo comportarse durante una fiesta fetiche.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Buscando el perdón de mis hijos; Hijo por adicción
programme.desc: La madre de Eduardo está en vida vegetal y ahora su padre reaparece para recuperar a la familia. Por otro lado, Fernando descubre que su ex involucra a su niño en estafas de seguros de autos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sacrificio por amor; Pelea en redes sociales
programme.desc: Gilberto es menor de edad y se casa, sin permiso, con una mujer mucho mayor que él. Además, Leo y Pikete son dos "influencers" que sostienen una rivalidad para ver quién tiene mayor alcance.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Franco es policía y demanda a su ex Johana porque ella finge el secuestro de sus hijos para huir de sus maltratos. Exagente de ICE deporta a su papá, ahora quiere hacer lo mismo con su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Arlet pide el divorcio de Víctor, él tiene otras mujeres a quienes obliga a comportarse como si fuesen perras. Sofía vive en una tribu de madres solteras, el padre de su hijo exige la custodia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La bailarina exótica; Los viejos se rebelan
programme.desc: A Talía la botan de la casa por enseñar a la hija de Jeny a bailar y a cobrar por hacerlo. Annette demanda a Angélica, dueña del hogar de ancianos donde su madre se enamoró de otra mujer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El hijo del coronel; Protector depredador
programme.desc: Cleris le exige a Stephanie que le devuelva a su hijo, lo dejó con ella para alejarlo de su padre, un militar cubano. Amanda demanda a su madre por dejarla con su padrastro, él abusó de ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El disparo oscuro; Amor a palo
programme.desc: Luego de dos meses en coma, tras una pelea doméstica, ya no tiene a sus hijos y ahora los quiere de vuelta. El esposo los descubre en la cama y, en medio de la pelea, el amante lo mata y huye.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Quiero ser de ella; La niña detective
programme.desc: Yuleika cree en la tradición latina de que los golpes enseñan y lo aplica con su hija de 20 años, incluso delante de su nieto. Isabela denuncia a su papá con la policía y lo deportan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gustavo es guardaespaldas y fue baleado durante el secuestro de la familia que protege. Además, Jorge descubre a Yanelis con el mecánico, ambos estaban en el garaje, desmayados y desnudos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La muerte, una opción; Señora de las cinco décadas
programme.desc: Olga ha dedicado toda su vida al cuidado de su hija, quien nació con problemas neuronales. Por otro lado, Rosa se enamora de un chico mucho más joven que ella y decide divorciarse.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: New Jersey police working the murder of a woman bludgeoned to death in her own bed first think her boyfriend did it. When a desperate family member contacts renowned psychic Nancy Orlen Weber, Nancy sees the boyfriend is innocent, and gives police details that help undo the real killer's alibi. New Orleans investigators are stumped when a young mother turns up beaten to death, her son gravely injured. The suspects-the husband and his friend-blame each other, so investigators turn to psychic Rosemarie Kerr. Tapping into the fallen wife's vibration, Rosemarie discovers a truth more horrifying than anyone imagined.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society dig into the urban legend of the "Lantern Man" in Le Sueur, Minnesota. Known locally as the "Brewery Hill Spook Light," the figure is rumored to walk the railroad tracks at night with a lantern. Adrian not only confirms the existence of the apparition but also reveals its identity and the reasons it haunts this area.

programme.title: Paranormal Contact
programme.desc: Jeff DeEll, Adam Myles, and Kelly Klassen explore haunted locations along Canada’s east coast, seeking contact with the dead and uncovering the hidden stories that linger in the shadows. Guided by intuition, research, and firsthand encounters, they venture deep into the unknown to give a voice to the spirits still waiting to be heard.

Blanca llora abrazada a su nieta. Junior recobra el conocimiento y pide ver a Rosa. Erasto descubre con horror que sus piernas no responden y entra en pánico. Arminda celebra disfrutando del castigo. Adolfo enfrenta a Marisela negándose al aborto. Alejandro y Rosalía viven en tensión permanente. Isaías se ofrece a apoyar a Rosa en su pesadilla familiar. Carmen Rosa, ya sin fuerzas, pide perdón a Rosa por todo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo suspende la boda y Rebeca, enojada, le dice que el padre de Leo es Miguel. Rodrigo finalmente firma su confesión, en la que expone todo el plan de Rebeca. Así que Carlos Ernesto va con la policía a la casa de los Ferrándiz para arrestarla al igual que a Adolfo y Edgar. Pero las cosas se complican cuando Rebeca se fuga. Alejandra sigue sin tener noticias de lo que está pasando y Maribel la va a visitar. Virginia está feliz porque finalmente se sepa quién mató a Miguel. Julio no se toma bien la acusación que Carlos Ernesto le hace a su mamá.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.sub-title: Episodio 6: No fue una metida de pata, fueron dos
programme.desc: Cristóbal y su primo Guillermo conversan en la plaza, Cristóbal se muestra aún vengativo con Marilda y empeñado en no fallar en su nuevo matrimonio con Ana. Pablo visita a su hija Ana y le cuenta del Fantasma, mientras Ana a él, de Guillermo, su verdadero amor. Venancio vuelve de buscar a su hijo del colegio, en el ascensor se cruza con Pedro, este se pone nervioso y Venancio lo percibe. Carlota recibe a Venancio y su nieto; Venancio expresa sus celos por Lázara. Pedro lo está espiando, nervioso, con sus cámaras, así se entera de que vive en el edificio. Mientras Barranco y Ana conversan, llega su ex, María José, y comienzan a discutir fuerte

programme.title: Episodio 107 (2026)
programme.desc: Briggite les cuenta a Ana y a Finita lo de Armando. Finita se desmaya Armando y Atanasio se encuentran y comienzan hablar de Graciela y en este momento de Briggite. Bienvenida va donde Junior y le dice que acepta trabajar en su película. Junior le entrega el guión con unas palabras que hacen llorar a Bienvenida Solymar se porta como novia de Wilker y este no dice nada. Yubiri cree esto y se va para que ellos hablen. Gisela y Juan Diego están de compras y ven a Yubiri.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Tanto Gabriel como Magdalena pelean con su pareja, porque éstos no les creen que la prensa armó una historia sobre ellos, que ellos dicen no es verdadera. Angie no se tranquiliza aún, y llama a un detective para vigilar la situación de cerca. Agustín aprovecha la escena para causarle culpa a Magdalena, mientras él la sigue engañando con Sofía. Luego, Magdalena va a una fiesta, donde tomas algunas fotos, y se encuentra con Ricardo, a quien le da una cachetada por haber escrito ese artículo sobre ella en la revista. Magdalena sale beneficiada por esto, ya que un hombre la felicita y le ofrece un trabajo en el interior del país.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia está fuera de peligro y revela su enfermedad a Ricardo, quien se desespera. Katiuska, furiosa tras ser expulsada de la clínica por Ricardo, ordena a Carrero eliminar a Celia. Mientras tanto, René se aleja definitivamente de Marcelo pese a los intentos de Graciela. Manuela perdona a Ricardo pero no olvida, enfocándose en el bienestar de Celia. Margot inicia una relación con Alejandro, y Marcelo se enfrenta violentamente a Gustavo por el amor de María del Pilar.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina asesina a su hermana Rebeca para salvar a Irene y a su bebé. Luego los doctores revelan que ella sufría un trastorno de doble personalidad y que creía fervientemente que ella era en realidad su hermana muerta. Tony y Maribel terminan juntos, por comprar una nueva casa para irse a vivir juntos y formar una nueva familia. También Anzola termina casándose con Trinidad en una fiesta de casamiento a la cual toda la familia estuvo invitada. Felipe logra poner tras las rejas a Alejandra y a Rodrigo por los crímenes que cometieron. Antes de llevarlos a la prisión, deja a ella hacer su último descargo con Rodrigo en el que le confiesa que nunca lo perdonará por arruinarle la vida.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Episodio 108 (2026)
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa. A Gabriel le ofrecen ir a hacer un discurso a Caja Seca, un pueblo cercano, para, entre otras cosas, desviar la atención de los medios por el problema con Magdalena. Gabriel acepta, y Gloria lo acompaña.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Los médicos informan que a Celia le queda poco tiempo de vida; Katiuska envía a Carrero para eliminarla, pero él huye al ser descubierto. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior, ignorando que Rosa es su hermana, le jura amor eterno y le pide casarse cuanto antes. Rosa siente la angustia de no poder decirle la verdad. Erasto queda postrado por parálisis total y Arminda lo cuida con satíricos remedios. Eustoquio celebra el castigo divino y proyecta apoderarse de la fortuna. Adolfo decide contarle a Junior la verdad sobre Rosa pero teme su reacción por su delicado estado. Consuelo ruega a Blanca por consejos. Rosa busca refugio en Isaías. Carmen Rosa fallece en su cama dejando a Rosa huérfana de su único amor materno verdadero.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story (2023)
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax (2023)
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with an undersea walk before heading to Port Louis to meet Lloyd in Chinatown. A massive archway welcomes him onto the busy Chinatown streets and Brent and Lloyd whet their appetites with some Chinese street food. The Chinese influence on Mauritian food has been huge and there have been more than a few fusion dishes to come out of their Chinatown. Brent and Lloyd head to a local Chinese restaurant to try a popular dish that is unique to Mauritius, a Bol Renverse, an "upside-down bowl". After a delicious lunch Lloyd has a treat planned for Brent. He takes him to the Kwan Tee Pagoda, the oldest Pagoda in Mauritius and believed to be the oldest in the Southern Hemisphere. After a magical day Brent head's back to his hotel inspired and ready to cook up a storm. The next day Brent goes in search of ingredients in a local Chinese supermarket and then heads to a peaceful garden to cook his mustard pork with a twist.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole

programme.desc: We explore the Outer Banks. Starting the day out at the beach discovering wild horses. From there we go to the National Wright Brothers Monument where the first fliights took place. We top off our day visiting some historic lighthouse and some local cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We discover Franklin, TN also known to its locals for being voted as best small town in TN. Adventure starts our day, with a thrilling and beautiful ride showcasing the town views in a hot air balloon ride. From there we explore the history of downtown Franklin and end the day with some amazing southern cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole

programme.desc: We live like a local in The Hamptons. From paddle boarding the morning away to learning about art and history from the local experts we see everything the Hamptons has to offer. We top off the day with a classic float from the locals favorite spot.

programme.desc: We explore the West Village in NYC, known to most as one of the most iconic neighborhoods in Manhattan. From sea salt cookies to handmade toys and collectibles we get to know the neighborhood first hand through its innovative locals and shops.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.sub-title: Amazonas - Shadows of the Rubber Boom
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: FernGully ... the Last Rainforest (1992)
programme.desc: A lumberjack helps a tribe of rain-forest elves protect their kingdom from an evil spirit and greedy clear-cutters.

programme.title: Bloodfist VI: Ground Zero (1994)
programme.desc: A kickboxer must prevent the launch of a nuclear missile by terrorists targeting New York.

programme.title: Cover-Up (1991)
programme.desc: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv.

programme.title: Freejack (1992)
programme.desc: Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009, where his mind will be replaced with that of a dead billionaire.

programme.title: Dead Man (1995)
programme.desc: Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.

programme.title: FernGully 2: The Magical Rescue (1998)
programme.desc: Two Fern Gully faeries leave the rain forest to save three baby animals from poachers.

programme.title: Affliction (1997)
programme.desc: A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).

programme.title: The Return of Hunter: Everyone Walks in L.A. (1995)
programme.desc: Los Angeles police lieutenant Rick Hunter (Fred Dryer) seeks the media-hungry serial killer (Miguel Ferrer) who killed his fiancée.

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael (1990)
programme.desc: An offbeat Ohio teenager (Winona Ryder) eagerly awaits the return of a legendary wild one she figures is her mother.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch (1996)
programme.desc: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

programme.title: Prehysteria! 3 (1995)
programme.desc: Pygmy dinosaurs help the owner (Fred Willard) of a miniature golf course fight off bank foreclosure and takeover by his greedy brother (Bruce Weitz).

programme.title: Some Girl (1998)
programme.desc: An insecure young woman (Marissa Ribisi) and her promiscuous best friend (Juliette Lewis) seek relationships.

programme.title: Lawnmower Man 2: Beyond Cyberspace (1996)
programme.desc: An evil corporation planning an inescapable global computer network hires a mentally impaired laborer (Matt Frewer) made into a genius by virtual reality.

programme.title: Prehysteria (1993)
programme.desc: An evil archaeologist tries to exploit five pygmy dinosaurs that hatched in a family's basement.

programme.title: Love hurts (2024)
programme.desc: Germana is an untalented and unlucky aspiring actress, a somewhat inconsiderate mother and the mistress of a rich lawyer who supports her financially. Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

programme.title: Wild Boys (2026)
programme.desc: Five delinquent youths escape a reformatory and embark on a violent, lawless spree across the country.

programme.title: Murder Obsession (2025)
programme.desc: Michael Stanford, a promising young actor, suffers from the stress caused by his job. Fatigue creates large gaps in his memory and makes him unstable character-wise. Therefore, Michael decides to retreat to his mother's house, inviting the entire film crew as well.

programme.title: La moglie in vacanza l'amante in città (2025)

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Jersey Shore star undergoes 6-pack surgery! Housewives on drug-spiked cheese? The benefits of cow cuddling? DIY facial! Are women happier with younger men? Autistic man’s amazing weight loss. New fitness trend: crawling emotional support alligator. The fruit you need to eat!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors “Race to Erase 10 Years” on a lucky audience member! Just wait until you see The jaw-dropping results! Candle explosion: could it happen to you? People are suing The major cereal companies over “nutritious” and “wholesome” claims! Guest loses 170 pounds but it isn’t enough! Find out what still is weighing her down. The Doctors discusses a new study that claims going vegan leads to depression! Product claims to whiten teeth 6 shades lighter in just 3 days? Does it work or is it 50 shades of disappointment? We’re putting it to The test! Plus, The water bottle danger you haven’t heard!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Can a high-tech surveillance company keep your kids safe at school? Attorney and psychologist Lisa Strohman weighs in on the hot-button issue. OB/GYN facing charges of health care fraud after allegedly performing unnecessary surgeries on patients! Is the paleo diet safe while breastfeeding? A controversial new bill in Colorado is proposing young adults be tried as juveniles because the brain isn’t fully developed. Neuroscientist Dr. Don Vaughn and attorney and psychologist Dr. Lisa Strohman debate the pros and cons.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Woman Amputates Leg to Save Baby
programme.desc: Inspiring story of a mom who decided to amputate her leg after a motorcycle crash to save her unborn baby. #DropTheSugar Dollar Store challenge proves you can eat healthy on a budget! Hundreds of women getting scammed with pregnancy congratulations cards? CBD vending machines coming to a convenience store near you!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: “Ask The Doctors” episode. Woman who can’t stop urinating herself! Could you enhance your “manhood” with stem cells? Sleep doctor helps woman who shouts in her sleep! Why do you wake up every night … at the same time? We know why! Hollywood’s hottest plastic surgeons discuss the latest cosmetic trends! Dr. Nita Landry answers all your gyno questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: How To Stay Healthy This Fall?
programme.desc: School is back in session and The Doctors are assigning homework. Get the facts on germs, illness and immunizations. And, how to prevent lice!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Drs: Why Does That Smell?
programme.desc: From foul gas to smelly ears, The Doctors answer your most pressing questions about the odors your body produces. And, editor-in-chief of Prevention, Liz Vaccariello, separates fact from fiction about a common medical myth.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It’s The Doctors’ Fans’ Favorites special - from the stories that broke your heart to the stories that broke the internet, we’re delivering ten years of our most memorable moments! A mother loses her hearing and spends fifteen years in silence until cochlear implant surgery. Our cameras were with her in the operating room and The unforgettable moment when she heard her son’s voice for the first time. See how they’re doing now! Remember the 685-pound teen with the voice of angel? Find out if he’s lost weight! Don’t miss the biggest transformations and the most-watched clip in The Doctors history!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It’s THE DOCTORS’ Thanksgiving Leftover Show packed with goodies that didn’t fit on our first plate! In a new edition of The Doc Tank, we bring you wild and wacky health products from a pancake robot to a bike you ride laying down to a pillow that claims to help you snooze more soundly! Then, why do women cheat? Could Instagram be fueling infidelity? Go inside a training camp for service dogs to watch them transform from pup to personal assistant! Plus, could this common workout mistake be the reason you’re not seeing the results you want? And, an easy tip to cut calories this holiday season!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Take your sex life from ordinary to extraordinary! Get Dr. Ruth’s tips to pleasure your partner and make the most out of foreplay and lovemaking. Plus, get the recipe for the concoction that will make your man go all night!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It's time for another round of the most embarrassing questions! Learn everything you've always wanted to know but were too afraid to ask - no subject is off-limits! And, learn how to get rid of those flabby arms once and for all!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Milk, eggs, medicine and sneakers all have one thing in common: limited shelf lives. But do you really need to toss them by a certain date? THE DOCTORS reveal when something is safe to keep and when you should throw it away! Do you know what lurks in your mattress and linens? See the shocking results one couple receives, and learn how to keep your bed clean and safe. You don’t always need an expiration date to tell you when food has gone bad. Learn a simple trick to identify a good egg from a bad egg. And, leftovers don’t come with an “eat-by” date. THE DOCTORS explain when your leftovers should head to the trash can. Do you have a hard time parting with comfortable old shoes? Find out the shelf life for your sneakers, and see why you might want to toss out your old kicks.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Get the facts about women's heart disease with singer and philanthropist Barbra Streisand, founder of the eponymous cardiovascular research program. And, cardiologist Dr. Noel Bairey shares vital tests every woman must take.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Parents of TV star Cameron Boyce raise awareness about the medical condition that took their son’s life. A woman caused an emergency flight landing after she faked a medical emergency – to get a bigger seat! Would you pay a matchmaker to help you make friends? Could The secret to the perfect orthotics be 3D printing? Bride lets social media strangers create her wedding! Three snacks that will help ease muscle cramps!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors explores a community project aimed at healing the sick – with food! A new discovery could mean a cure for alcoholism? A young mom begins losing her vision after pregnancy? Beauty blogger recommends DIY lightening down there? A dad forced to change his daughter’s diaper on a dirty restaurant bathroom floor – and you won’t believe the photo!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: People know that smoking causes cancer and continue to puff anyway, but could you be doing something you didn’t know was bad for you? The Doctors reveals some of the health mistakes you never knew you were making.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A previous guest who was addicted to exercise and referred to as the “sickest person ever on The show” returns with an unexpected update. Then, can cold medicine be used as a murder defense? The Doctors discusses the much buzzed about court case. Plus, our Stool Squad spins The “Wheel of Poop” and answers all your questions about… “Number Two”! And, The Doctors tackles the new research that points to the root cause of ADHD being sleep issues?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Tone, tighten and sculpt your booty with celebrity trainer David Kirsch’s signature exercises! And, how to get rid of adult acne, eliminate crow’s feet and look a size smaller in less than 60 seconds!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Sometimes bigger is better! Learn when excess can lead to success. Do bigger butts indicate good health? Find out. The Doctors race through an oversized obstacle course. See who wins! Plus, meet the world’s largest dog.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: What to Do if Disaster Strikes
programme.desc: When disaster strikes, would you know what to do? Are you prepared for earthquakes, tornadoes, hurricanes, blizzards and more? Plus, five things you can do to increase your chance of surviving a plane crash.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Does sex put you in a trance? Could having a baby later in life boost your brainpower? How are hair stylists saving lives? Find out! Then, meet “The Iron Nun”! She’s racing 140+ miles at a time … at age 86! Dr. Phil talks couples therapy do’s and don’ts and one school’s extreme safety drill. Plus, Dr. Phil’s secrets to surviving the holidays with diabetes! The unbelievable feats of daredevil Jonathan Goodwin!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: How far would you go for beauty? A controversial surgery alters feet so women can wear heels. And, an acupuncture facelift that claims to take years off a woman's appearance. And, the latest in laser surgery that erases tattoos.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, Teen Mom OG stars Catelynn and Tyler Baltierra open up about Catelynn’s treatment for postpartum depression and the recent tabloid divorce rumors! Plus, he went from bullied to buff, and now one of your favorite guests returns to show off his skin removal! See the surgery closer than ever… from a Go-Pro camera on the surgeon’s head! And, one teen’s amazing transformation after a surgery to straighten the 180-degree angle in his head and neck!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Is Your Body a Ticking Time Bomb?
programme.desc: The Doctors reveals surprising symptoms that may indicate your life is at risk. From stroke, diabetes and thyroid function, to liver, kidney and heart failure; find out how to stop a medical catastrophe before it happens.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Investigation into home food sensitivity tests – are they legit or a waste of a time and money? Shocking story of mom’s debilitating stimulant addiction! Class action lawsuit over vitamin shots? The craziest things dogs have eaten in “My Dog Ate What?”

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Breast Implants Made Me Sick
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, a former Playboy Playmate claims her implants made her sick and says she’s not the only one! Derek Hough reveals how he stays fit and gives the inside scoop on his new show! Find out why some parents are potty training their kids … in public! A young man with a family history of early-onset Alzheimer’s turns to The Doctors! What will be revealed? Get the warning signs you need to know! Plus, a hoarder finally finds freedom … how did she do it?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Plagued by rumors of crack use, meth use, cancer and his HIV status, pop star Aaron Carter comes to The Doctors in a world exclusive to find out what’s really going. Can Aaron on be saved from The wreckage of superstardom? In Part 2 of our Aaron Carter exclusive, The Doctors is tasked with delivering the news to Aaron about his blood tests for HIV and meth use.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Embarrassing, Gross, and Wild Special brings you some of The Doctors’ most unforgettable moments! See “The Great Pop-Off”! Relive Dr. Pimple Popper’s biggest and best pops! Marvel at the courage of guests who shared Their most embarrassing problems to raise awareness! From the huge, painful keloids that isolated a school teacher to The severe birthmarks that tormented a young woman, These guests stepped out of the shadows for help. Don’t miss one man’s 315-pound transformation! Laugh and learn as Dr. Ordon and NBA star Jon Salley undergo prostate exams backstage! Score a simple fix for dry, chalky elbows.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors count down the top C words that cause consternation. And, new treatments for corns, calluses and constipation!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: THE DOCTORS tests an app that promises to measure just how ugly you are and the results aren’t pretty! Find out why a hospital billed a couple for holding their newborn! In a THE DOCTORS exclusive, Olivia Newton-John’s daughter, Chloe Lattanzi, reveals the truth behind the plastic surgery rumors! Then, baseball legend Darryl Strawberry discusses his battle with addiction and his attempt to reach out to NBA star Lamar Odom! Plus, the hidden dangers of Halloween make-up

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Considering plastic surgery of any kind? Don't miss Krissy's story and Dr. Ordon's essential do's and don'ts to keep you safe. Watch several controversial potty training techniques in action and see if any of them are right for your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ways To Take Charge Of Your Health
programme.desc: Is a simple seasoning the culprit for expanding waistlines? Most Americans consume two to three times the amount of salt necessary per day. The Nutrition Twins, registered dieticians, believe excess salt is largely to blame for America’s obesity epidemic. Learn their secret to staying skinny and try the diet designed to kick the salt habit for good! THE DOCTORS joins forces with Iams pet food to support Iams’ Home 4 the Holidays pet adoption program. Learn the health benefits of pets, for both humans and animals alike! A controversial court ruling in a worker’s compensation case may change the way employers hire. Will your weight jeopardize your job prospects? Plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon demonstrates the latest wrinkle-relaxer on 35-year-old Jennifer. See the amazing after results! If you’re trying to lose weight, studies have shown that when you eat may be more important than what you eat. Snacking at the wrong time can increase your weight gain by 50 percent! Find out when to nibble and when to just say no. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears uncovers hidden choking dangers for toddlers and demonstrates what to do if your child’s airway is obstructed.

programme.desc: David Kepesh is growing old. He's a professor of literature, a student of American hedonism, and an amateur musician and photographer. When he finds a student attractive, Consuela, a 24-year-old Cuban, he sets out to seduce her. Along the way, he swims in deeper feelings, maybe he's drowning. She presses him to sort out what he wants from her, and a relationship develops. They talk of traveling. He confides in his friend, George, a poet long-married, who advises David to grow up and grow old. She invites him to meet her family. His own son, from a long-ended marriage, confronts him. Is the elegy for lost relationships, lost possibilities, beauty and time passing, or failure of nerve?

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E05 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E05 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Oliver Takes Over The Phone Company
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Count Your Tomatoes Before They're Picked
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Kind Word For The President
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: How To Succeed In TV Without Really Trying
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 2)
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.
